race.title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: Two-time course winner DOCTOR GRACE is taken to capitalise on a return to calmer waters. Expound could be a serious threat, especially if the market speaks in his favour. In The Minus and Storm Eric also merit consideration. DOCTOR GRACE (IRE) EXPOUND IN THE MINUS (IRE)
